Incident explorer

Inspect extracted Oil, Ghee and Milk event evidence

Browse the current Oil release, incident-scope-retained Ghee events, Ghee records the model left unclear, and the Oil/Ghee-parity Milk relevant and unclear records. Event fields, exact evidence, accepted ontology triplets and retained unresolved triplets remain linked to the source article. TTD/Tirupati case-family titles are excluded.

Model event labels and claim status are separate. Suspected and alleged events can remain relevant without being presented as laboratory-confirmed facts, while provisional records are explicitly marked. An unclear label is a review state, not a settled incident. Ghee scope-review holds and TTD-case articles excluded by title remain preserved in separate research archives.
